Stock/spoilage and viability unknown. Reported prior-week shop takings $3,000, wages $420, rent/running $250, leaving $2,330 before stock and unlisted costs, $1,980 after $350 draw. Lewis says $650 repair comes out today; displayed shop account remains $4,240, payment not verified; conditional balance $3,590 if no other changes. $2,100 difference remains unreconciled.
